result_text:
The full offline suite (`mvn -q -o test`) finished with exit code 0 and no failure output. The quiet flag means it printed no per-test counts, so the exit code is the evidence. Together with the earlier targeted run (31 tests passing), the change is verified.

The support-agent change is unchanged and not committed. It adds a nullable `agent` column to `support_ticket`, an `agent` field on `SupportTicket`, and carries the agent through every ticket query, the create path and status changes. It also adds a test, `agentStaysWithTicketThroughStatusChanges`, in `SupportTicketTest`.
